title: : Senior Software Engineer – Infrastructure
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce Mulesoft- Remoto
description:
Role Overview:


  • Advanced English


  • Lead client discussions regarding technical requirements and design.


  • Design and implement integration processes using MuleSoft.


  • Demonstrated experience in API development and connecting MuleSoft with Salesforce and other systems.


  • Develop software programs according to technical specifications, adhering to programming standards and procedures, performing unit testing, implementing program modifications, and resolving issues by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.


  • Gather requirements and design integration architecture, facilitating client discussions on data ingestion using files, streaming, bulk loads, APIs, or direct database connections.


  • Proficiency in Apex, Classes, Batch, Triggers, JavaScript, CSS3, HTML5, databases, JIRA, and Git version control is essential.


  • Experience working in agile projects and familiarity with SCRUM, Kanban methodologies, and agile tools.


  • Provide insights and contribute to the enhancement and maintenance of applications and programs.


  • Execute detailed and complex unit tests, secure code testing, and issue resolution.


  • Support integration, system, and performance testing, as well as code optimization.


  • Identify and promote opportunities for code, configuration, procedure, and technique reuse.


✅ Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree required


  • Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields is preferred.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience required.


  • Technical skills – MuleSoft development.


  • Hands-on experience configuring Salesforce.com, including creating custom objects, fields, buttons, links, record types, formula fields, field dependencies, validation rules, workflows, and approval processes.


  • Development and customization of Salesforce.com applications using reusable Lightning components, Lightning pages, Lightning data services, Apex classes, Apex triggers, page layouts, sharing rules, static resources, and migration tools within Sales and Service Cloud, including portal development for customers and partners.


  • Practical experience with Web Services/SOA and Metadata APIs.


  • Experience creating custom Web Services to handle inbound requests and outbound calls to external Web Services.


  • Proficiency in writing SOQL and SOSL queries and adhering to governance guidelines.


  • Web development skills including JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript scripting languages, DHTML, SOAP, and AJAX.


  • Hands-on experience implementing data security using access controls.


  • Proficiency in migrating data from legacy applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader Utility.


  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and development tools using Agile frameworks and methodologies (Jira/Confluence, Visual Studio, Eclipse).


  • Experience managing multi-country implementations and multiple Salesforce.com instances.


  • Familiarity with best practices across Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning, and Lightning platforms.


  • Experience configuring and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.


  • MuleSoft Platform Developer certifications are desirable for this role.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
Data Architect with Trade Promotion Experience

Remote

Long term Contract


Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities

  • Create a data-connected ecosystem that integrates various data sources to provide comprehensive insights for trade promotion optimization.
  • Stablish and promote best practices for data management, analytics, and trade promotion strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate both functional and non-functional requirements into a cohesive, end-to-end data-driven trade optimization architecture.
  • Ensure the architecture aligns with business goals and technical constraints.
  • Provide training and support to team members and stakeholders on the use of the TPO system and best practices.


Competencies / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and platforms (e.g., SQL, Hanna, Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and Governance.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Understanding of trade promotion strategies, consumer goods industry, and market trends.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to trade promotions.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Senior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Principais Responsabilidades:


Implementar soluções técnicas desenhadas pelo Arquiteto de Soluções, garantindo a qualidade e performance.

Desenvolver e customizar componentes dentro das plataformas Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein Bot).

Realizar integrações entre Salesforce e outros sistemas, utilizando APIs (REST/SOAP), Webhooks e outras tecnologias.

Participar ativamente do ciclo de desenvolvimento, incluindo análise técnica, implementação, testes e deploy.

Otimizar fluxos de trabalho no Salesforce, automatizando processos e implementando funcionalidades conforme as necessidades do negócio.

Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e stakeholders para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.

Atuar na manutenção de soluções existentes, corrigindo problemas e implementando melhorias contínuas.

Garantir conformidade com as melhores práticas de segurança e governança da Salesforce.


Requisitos:


Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, especialmente Marketing Cloud.

Forte habilidade com Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components e Salesforce APIs.

Experiência com integração de Salesforce via APIs REST/SOAP, Webhooks e conectores.

Experiência com automação de campanhas e jornadas de clientes dentro do Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).

Conhecimento em segurança e conformidade de dados dentro da Salesforce.

Capacidade de seguir arquiteturas e padrões desenhados pelo Arquiteto de Soluções, garantindo consistência e alinhamento com a estratégia técnica.


Diferenciais:


Conhecimento prático em Data Cloud.

Experiência em desenvolvimento de bots personalizados com o Einstein Bot para automação de jornadas de atendimento e interação com clientes.

Experiência prévia com plataformas conversacionais integradas ao Salesforce, como Whatsapp.

Certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I ou Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer.


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- Salesforce

- Git

- Visualforce

- Apex

- DATA CLOUD

- Lightning Components

- EINSTEIN BOT

- MARKETING CLOUD

- API | APIS | API'S


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe

- Autonomia, Proatividade e Iniciativa


Metodologias:


- Agile


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Principais Responsabilidades:


Implementar soluções técnicas desenhadas pelo Arquiteto de Soluções, garantindo a qualidade e performance.

Desenvolver e customizar componentes dentro das plataformas Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein Bot).

Realizar integrações entre Salesforce e outros sistemas, utilizando APIs (REST/SOAP), Webhooks e outras tecnologias.

Participar ativamente do ciclo de desenvolvimento, incluindo análise técnica, implementação, testes e deploy.

Otimizar fluxos de trabalho no Salesforce, automatizando processos e implementando funcionalidades conforme as necessidades do negócio.

Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e stakeholders para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.

Atuar na manutenção de soluções existentes, corrigindo problemas e implementando melhorias contínuas.

Garantir conformidade com as melhores práticas de segurança e governança da Salesforce.

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, especialmente Marketing Cloud.

Forte habilidade com Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components e Salesforce APIs.

Experiência com integração de Salesforce via APIs REST/SOAP, Webhooks e conectores.

Experiência com automação de campanhas e jornadas de clientes dentro do Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).

Conhecimento em segurança e conformidade de dados dentro da Salesforce.

Capacidade de seguir arquiteturas e padrões desenhados pelo Arquiteto de Soluções, garantindo consistência e alinhamento com a estratégia técnica.

Conhecimento prático em Data Cloud.

Experiência em desenvolvimento de bots personalizados com o Einstein Bot para automação de jornadas de atendimento e interação com clientes.

Experiência prévia com plataformas conversacionais integradas ao Salesforce, como Whatsapp.

Certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I ou Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer.

title: AI Fullstack Developer
description:
Role Description

We are looking for a talented AI Fullstack Developer to join our growing team. This role involves working across the stack, from building scalable backend services to developing modern front-end experiences, while also integrating AI-powered features into our applications.  


As an AI Fullstack Developer, you’ll work with technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Apollo, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP). You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, innovative solutions that leverage AI/ML services and APIs.  


This is a full-time, remote role offering the opportunity to work on challenging, AI-driven projects with global impact.  


Key Responsibilities 

  • Design, develop, and maintain fullstack web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS  
  • Build and manage GraphQL APIs and services with Apollo 
  • Develop scalable, secure backend systems integrated with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) 
  • Explore, implement, and optimize **AI/ML services, APIs, and cloud-based AI tools**  
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices  
  • Test, debug, and deploy applications for performance and reliability  
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver features end-to-end  


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in Fullstack Development (frontend + backend)  
  • Proficiency with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Apollo
  • Experience with AWS or GCP, especially AI/ML-related services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, AI APIs)  
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and API integrations*
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their application in software development is a strong plus  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience  
  • Strong problem-solving, teamwork, and communication skills  
  • Ability to thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and collaborative environment


Perks & Benefits

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere  
  • Full-time employment with long-term stability  
  • Salary: 2,000.00 – 2,500.00 USD per month

title: Business Analyst - AI Oriented
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about transforming information into actionable insights. You thrive at the intersection of business and technology, leveraging AI-powered analytics and automation to deliver smarter decision-making tools. You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to modernize data ecosystems and drive measurable business outcomes through predictive intelligence and efficiency.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Analysis or BI roles, preferably with a focus on AI-enhanced data solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel (including automation and AI-powered functions).
  • Experience using BI tools such as Tableau or MicroStrategy, and working knowledge of ETL frameworks.
  • Proven track record in leading data integration projects, developing predictive models, and supporting executive-level reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, capable of translating business requirements into effective data solutions.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data environments and AI-driven analytics practices (nice to have).
  • English Full Professional Proficiency.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement AI-driven dashboards and data models using Power BI, SQL, and Excel to support predictive analytics and performance optimization.
  • Manage end-to-end BI modernization initiatives, including data warehouse expansion, ETL automation, and AI capability integration.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data solutions in collaboration with data engineering and technology teams.
  • Develop and optimize automated reporting workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring timely delivery of analytics projects and reports.
  • Support executive-level reporting by delivering real-time insights that enhance decision-making across campaign tracking, financial planning, and strategic initiatives.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve reporting, visualization, and data accessibility.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer


Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm?


Look no further! WebCreek is hiring a DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.


This role focuses on ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure through automation, continuous integration, and deployment best practices. You’ll take the lead on optimizing cloud environments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and implementing monitoring and security strategies to support high-performance software delivery. In this fast-paced environment, your expertise will be key to driving efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement across all development and operations processes.


What You'll Do

  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
  • Deploy and manage infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Terraform (IaC).
  • Automate processes with PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools.
  • Ensure smooth integration between on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to enhance delivery pipelines.
  • Apply security and compliance best practices across systems and workflows.


What You Have

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.
  • Strong background in CI/CD automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, including integration with on-premises infrastructure (hybrid environments).
  • Solid scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
  • A strong automation mindset, focused on simplifying workflows and reducing manual processes.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading projects and mentoring teams.
  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or other distributed caching/search technologies.
  • Familiarity with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.


What You'll Gain

  • A full-time position with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Competitive salary with regular performance-based reviews.
  • Access to top-tier benefits and professional development programs.
  • In-house IT training and industry-recognized certifications.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.
  • Health care expense sponsorship to support your well-being.
  • Fitness sponsorship to help you stay active and healthy.
  • Work with top global brands and industry-leading companies.
  • A collaborative international team with opportunities to work abroad.


Who We Are

WebCreek provides world- class software development teams and technical staff augmentation to Fortune 500 companies and other global industry leaders. With over 29 years of experience and a global presence spanning 20+ offices across North America, Latin America, Asia, and Europe, we deliver top-tier digital solutions to the companies that power the world.


WebCreek is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

description:

Are you looking to join a highly regarded IT development firm?


Look no further! WebCreek is hiring a DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience and a high level of English to work remotely from Latin America.

description:

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior com sólida experiência em Java , Node.js e Arquiteturas avançadas para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. A pessoa ideal será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance, assim como atuar próximo ao Tech Lead para definições técnicas para o desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar Tech Lead em Definições Técnica: Orientar decisões arquiteturais, definir stack tecnológico e estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Auxiliar Desenvolvimento: Auxiliar em dúvidas tecnicas equipes, conduzir code reviews e desenvolver programadores pleno/júnior;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar aplicações para alta performance, implementar estratégias de cache e load balancing;
  • Segurança Corporativa: Implementar práticas de segurança, auditoria de código e compliance com padrões enterprise;
  • Integração Complexa: Desenvolver integrações críticas com sistemas legados, APIs de terceiros e serviços externos;
  • Disaster Recovery: Projetar estratégias de backup, recuperação e alta disponibilidade;
  • Inovação Técnica: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, POCs e melhorias de processo;
  • Gestão de Incidentes: Auxiliar troubleshooting de problemas críticos em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de Microserviços: Criar e manter APIs REST utilizando Spring Boot e NestJS para sistemas de alta disponibilidade;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Documentação: Manter documentação técnica atualizada e especificações de APIs;
  • Testes Automatizados: Desenvolver testes unitários, integração e contratos (PACT) garantindo qualidade do código;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Implementar comunicação entre serviços via RabbitMQ, OpenFeign e APIs externas;
  • Gestão de Dados: Desenvolver soluções com MongoDB, bancos relacionais (JPA/Hibernate) e Redis para cache.


Requisitos

  • Arquitetura Avançada: Domain-Driven Design, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture;
  • Java/Spring Ecosystem: Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud Gateway, Spring Security, WebFlux;
  • Node.js (Avançado), NestJS, Express, Event Loop optimization, clustering;
  • Databases: Modelagem avançada, sharding, replicação, performance tuning;
  • Distributed Systems: Consensus algorithms, CAP theorem, eventual consistency;
  • Cloud Native: AWS/Azure/GCP, Terraform, service mesh, observability;
  • DevOps Avançado: Kubernetes operators, Helm charts, GitOps;
  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka;
  • Testes: JUnit, Jest, Mockito, TestContainers
  • Versionamento: Git, GitLab/GitHub.


Diferenciais

  • Big Data: Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, data streaming;
  • Machine Learning: MLOps, model serving, data pipelines;
  • Blockchain/Web3: Smart contracts, DeFi protocols;
  • Edge Computing: CDN optimization, edge functions.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

title: Senior Player Support Specialist
description:
Bring It On is creating the next generation of skill games. We deliver games that people enjoy for many years while earning money by playing excellently! Skill is the most exciting category in the games industry that enjoys rapid growth and immense opportunities.


In our culture, everyone has maximum impact, which means you will get the autonomy you deserve and the trust you yearn for. You will join a world-class team of support specialists to communicate with players, catering to their needs, charming them with your communications and communicating matters to the rest of the team.


Team members come with vast experience and will be among the most positive, professional, engaged, and fun people you’ve worked with. They will expect to find the same in you. Are you ready to create awesomeness?


Responsibilities

● Provide daily support to our players via iMessage, Facebook Messenger, and emails.

● Develop an in-depth understanding of our game features, events, and player activities to deliver knowledgeable responses.

● Troubleshoot player issues and work closely with internal teams to resolve game-related problems.

● Maintain detailed documentation of player interactions and issues using our CRM.

● Act as the voice of our players, collecting their feedback and communicating it to relevant departments for continuous product improvement.

● Assist with onboarding new players, helping them learn the game and ensuring they understand our features.

● Identify playing patterns and player behavior through analytical tools, using insights to guide player interaction strategies.

● Collaborate with other teams to provide promotional offers and inform players about new game features and events.

● Develop guidelines and procedures for future support team members.

● Hire and train a support team.


Requirements

● Minimum 4 years of experience in a customer support role, ideally in iGaming. Alternatively, similar experience in Quality Assurance in iGaming.

● Past experience in KYC, and working with payments processors.

● Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.

● Proficiency with CRM tools and experience documenting interactions.

● Strong empathy, with an ability to listen attentively and provide tailored solutions.

● Excellent time management skills and the ability to work flexible hours.

● Experience working in remote settings and self-driven to work independently.


Advantages

● Proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Spanish, Chinese) is a plus.

● Experience with analytics or proficiency in Excel is preferred.


Perks

● Attractive salary that meets your expectations.

● Stock options - when the company succeeds, you become rich.

● Home office budget - craft a top-notch environment to create wonders from.

● No physical office - work from anywhere you want to.

● Enjoy a culture focused on results and creating amazing player experiences.


We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.


If you feel the above describes you perfectly - Apply now!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About RealQuant

RealQuant is building the first vertical AI platform for commercial real estate — connecting underwriting, asset management, and reporting into one intelligent end-to-end workflow.


We’re not just another proptech tool — we’re building the infrastructure layer modern deal teams will run on .


Our MVP (Supabase + Clerk + Vercel + React/TypeScript) is nearly complete.


Your mission: finish and harden it, productionize it, and lead our migration to an Azure-native platform as we scale from prototype to enterprise-grade system.


Tech Stack

Monorepo: Web App + Excel Add-in


Frontend

Next.js 15 · React · Tailwind · TypeScript · Office.js Excel Taskpane Add-in


Backend / Workflows

FastAPI (Container Apps) · Azure Durable Functions (orchestration / HITL)


Data Layer

Azure Postgres Flexible (RLS + pgBouncer) · Blob Storage · Azure Cache for Redis


Platform & Infra

API Management (APIM) · Azure Front Door + WAF · Private Endpoints / VNET


Security & Monitoring

Key Vault (Managed Identity) · App Insights / Monitor (traces + cost dashboards)


DevOps & Auth

GitHub Actions CI/CD · Clerk / Entra SSO


What You’ll Build

  • Complete and stabilize the MVP (Supabase → Azure migration).
  • Architect production-ready FastAPI microservices for parsing, ingestion & deal automation.
  • Orchestrate background & human-in-loop flows via Azure Durable Functions .
  • Extend the Excel Add-in for comps, sensitivities, and automated deal outputs (LOIs, pitch decks, summaries, recommended assumptions) .
  • Stand up observability dashboards, rate limits, and private-endpoint networking.
  • Leverage AI-assisted dev tools (Cursor, Claude Code ) to ship 10× faster and document as you go.


Expected Outcomes

  • MVP feature-complete and hardened with test coverage
  • Core data + API services deployed on Azure (Postgres Flexible + Functions)
  • Excel Add-in live with first connected workflow
  • Monitoring, alerts & RLS security verified
  • Average API latency < 300 ms ; background jobs < 10 s E2E


Experience

  • 7 + years full-stack (TypeScript + Python)
  • Deep Azure production experience (Functions, Container Apps, APIM, Key Vault)
  • Strong product sense and UX intuition for data-heavy apps
  • Fintech / PropTech background a plus
  • Fluent English · builder’s mindset · bias toward shipping


Selection Process

  • 90-minute async coding test.
  • Technical interview + repo review.
  • Paid trial sprint (build a real feature).


Compensation & Setup

Hourly Based on Experience: full-time remote, EST overlap, immediate start.


Opportunity to convert to core team role with long-term incentives.


How to Apply

Share your GitHub or portfolio and a short note describing a SaaS product you helped take from prototype to production.

title: Financial Analyst, Acquisitions
description:
Company

Homestead Communities (the “Company”) addresses the affordable housing crisis in the United States by providing safe, clean and supportive communities where working families and retirees can own or rent affordable, high-quality, single-family manufactured homes.  Founded in 2023, the Company was one of the ten largest buyers of manufactured housing communities (“MHC”) over the past two years. Homestead Communities is committed to responsible stewardship for its residents, providing engaging careers for its team members, and delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns to its investor. 

Homestead Communities is owned by its management team and one of the world’s largest, publicly-traded, international real estate investors. The Company combines proven, growth-orientated entrepreneurial leadership with institutional discipline and financial capability. This position offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a new enterprise with proven partners and the resources and experience to build a significant operating business.

Location

Anywhere in Brasil, (or Latin America).  The position is home-based.


Position Overview

The Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will use the Company’s financial model to project cash flows for potential acquisitions. Projections include initial capital, financing, and monthly operating income and expenses. Projections depend on analysis of MHC’s historic financial statements, current rent roll, and primary market research, all lead by the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions.  Further financial analysis, which may require additional market or property diligence, is typically needed to respond to property-specific questions and unique investment characteristics.

The position can be full-time or a minimum commitment of 25 hours weekly. If part-time, the candidate must have flexibility to meet carrying deadlines for workflow. The daily time commitment will vary with the Company’s deal flow. There will be times when there are multiple transactions at the same time and times when there are short deadlines.  There will be times between transactions that the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will assist in broader work related to acquisitions.

Responsibilities

·        Prepare cash flow projections for proposed acquisitions.

o   Detailed, monthly projections for ten-year hold period. Dozens of line-items used to specify assumptions and clearly calculate resulting values.

o   The Vice President, Acquisitions provides initial underwriting assumptions, sets deadlines, and provides quality assurance review. 

o   Review and understand historic financial statements from a MHC seller and/or broker.

o   Prepare return sensitivities to varying operating assumptions.

·        Research the competitive housing market of potential MHC acquisitions.

o   Identify comparable MHCs and call MHCs to determine their occupancy, rental rates, amenities, and housing stock.

o   Review rental rates for competitive apartments and single-family homes. Review sales values and absorption of for-sale single-family homes in the submarket.

·        Prepare Investment Committee memoranda summarizing the potential investment.

·        Supervise updates to various proprietary databases used in the acquisitions workflow.

o   Master MHC property and owner lists.

o   CRM lists and programs.

o   MHC sales comps through database searches and contact with MHC brokers.

·        Track trends in AI and SaaS tools that could further automate the Company’s acquisition process.


Reporting

·        Reports to and will be supported by our Vice President, Acquisitions. 

·       Consults with senior team members to refine operating assumptions (operating and capital expenses).


Advancement

·        The candidate will get broad exposure to the acquisition, management and ownership of MHCs. 

·   Broader financial analysis and coding opportunities exist if they fit the experience and interest of the candidate.

·        Further opportunities may include broader responsibilities sourcing and supporting acquisitions.

Qualifications

·        Expert in Microsoft Excel and comfortable with basic math functions. (Calculus is useless.)  Thorough understanding of income statements and balance sheets.

·        Work experience at minimum in summer internships in residential or commercial real estate brokerage, lending, investment or consulting; private equity; investment banking; or accounting. One or two years of full-time employment is desirable but not required. More familiarity with residential real estate is preferred.

·        Fluent in English.

Compensation

·        Annual salary highly competitive for the location and qualifications of the candidate.

·        Annual cash bonus target of 10% of total annual salary depending on the achievement of mutually-agreed goals.  

·        Paid time off, (“PTO”), at the candidate’s discretion, if full time. Three weeks of PTO if the candidate is part-time.

·        For candidates in the United States, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability and life insurance. 

·        For candidates in the United States, 401(k) with Company matching employee’s contributions up to 4% of employee’s compensation. Compensation will be increased for candidates who cannot take advantage of the 401(k) program.


Miscellaneous

·        Occasional, (two or three times annually), travel for Company events. Initial training in Dallas, Texas.

title: Senior Principal Software Fullstack UI Developer 100% REMOTE
description:
Title: Senior Principal Software Fullstack UI Developer

Location: Brazil (REMOTE)

Duration: Fulltime


(Product based industry experience MUST HAVE)

About the role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

The Client's Admin Console provides our customers with a single unified view into the Client's Platform, allowing them to fully utilize the rich set of cloud security features Client provides.


What’s in it for you

As a member of the UI engineering team, you will collaborate with backend service teams to develop the user interface for products. You will work on both the frontend as well as the web application backend, working closely with our backend teams on Machine Learning, Threat, DLP, IaaS, API’s and other cool technologies. Depending upon the role you are hired for, you may also work on the REST API Gateway which exposes our REST API’s to customers.


What you will be doing

title: Head of Compliance
description:
Head de Compliance — Reborn

Remoto | Full-time | Remuneração competitiva + bônus

A Reborn  é infra de pagamentos feita por quem executa. A gente roda volume real, em múltiplos nichos, com risco alto e crescimento mais alto ainda. Procuramos um(a) Head de Compliance sênior  para liderar a construção da nossa estrutura de Compliance, Risco e AML  — sem travar o crescimento.

O desafio

Arquitetar e operar, ponta a ponta, KYC/KYB, AML, antifraude, onboarding e monitoramento transacional . Integrar compliance dentro do produto  (no código, não só no papel), garantindo aderência a BACEN/LGPD/PCI e governança de nível enterprise.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenhar políticas e processos de onboarding, PLD-FT, retenções e chargeback .
  • Implantar rule engine , alertas, listas restritivas e investigações internas.
  • Definir critérios de aceitação/recusa de merchants  e decisões críticas (bloqueios/liberações).
  • Construir e liderar o time de compliance/risk ops/jurídico-regulatório .
  • Criar dashboards executivos  (alertas, cohorts de risco, CBK, FP, retenções).
  • Tocar relacionamento com bancos, adquirentes, bandeiras e reguladores .
  • Preparar a casa para licenciamento/subadquirência  e auditorias.
Requisitos (senior de verdade)
  • 6+ anos em Compliance/Risco/AML  em fintech, adquirente ou banco digital .
  • Histórico em montar estruturas do zero  e liderar times.
  • Domínio de BACEN, LGPD, PCI DSS, PLD/FT  e práticas internacionais.
  • Experiência com operações de alto volume  e verticais reguladas (e-com, nutra, aposta, info etc.).
  • Capacidade de decidir sob pressão, com rigor técnico + visão de produto .
  • Inglês avançado.
Diferenciais
  • Passagem por Pagar.me, Dock, Nuvei, Adyen, Ebanx, PayU, Stark, Stone  (ou similares).
  • Vivência com licenciamento , parcerias bancárias e FIDC .
  • Familiaridade com plataformas antifraude, screening, scoring  e automações.
O que oferecemos
  • Remuneração competitiva + bônus por performance .
  • Autonomia real  para decidir e executar.
  • Remoto-first , time de alta performance, zero politicagem.
  • Contexto de crescimento acelerado  e impacto direto no core do negócio.
Como se candidatar

Envie CV + cases (com números)  para 


Assunto: Head de Compliance — (Seu Nome)

No corpo do e-mail, responda:

  • Estrutura de compliance mais complexa que você montou (contexto e resultados).
  • Maior risco mitigado e como decidiu.
  • Ferramentas/sistemas que domina (KYC, antifraude, screening, MTA/MMM, BI).
  • Disponibilidade de início.

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Architect will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

  • +4 anos de experiência em design digital, com portfólio demonstrando projetos end-to-end.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The AI Full-Stack Engineer will be responsible for building and maintaining AI applications on top of existing LLM APIs. This role will focus on integration, building robust AI-driven applications, and optimizing their evaluation and performance. The AI Full-Stack Engineer will ensure that our AI applications are developed, configured, and adopted to meet evolving needs, with a strong emphasis on Python-based solutions.


Duties and Responsibilities:

AI Application Development and Integration

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure AI applications leveraging existing LLM APIs.
  • Implement and manage integrations with various AI platforms and services.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises, specifically tailored for AI functionalities.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for AI applications.
  • Monitor and optimize AI application performance and cost, including model evaluation and optimization.
  • Ensure data quality checks for AI models and applications; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Utilize Python libraries and frameworks relevant to AI application development.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate AI applications with existing systems.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary conduit among business leads, product managers, and AI/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for AI development.
  • Promote adoption of new AI capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for AI application deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for new AI features.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics for AI applications.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with existing LLM APIs and experience building applications on top of them.
  • Experience with integration of AI applications into existing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI-specific libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience with optimizing AI model evaluation and performance.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for AI applications.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 2+ years in AI engineering, full-stack development with an AI focus, or related domains within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or similar.
  • 6+ year in application development overall


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.
